title: K-flat cone presentation after homotopy localization
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with the recorded derived category D(O_Y) [def-pc-derived-category]. For any distinguished triangle T₀ in the homotopy category of cochain complexes of O_Y-modules, there exist K-flat complexes P and Q [def-pc-kflat-complex] and a cochain morphism p:P→Q such that Qh.mapTriangle(T₀) is isomorphic to Qh.mapTriangle(mappingCone.triangleh p). The isomorphism is of triangles including their connecting maps. There are no properness, Noetherian, boundedness or quasi-coherence hypotheses.

source.place: K-flat replacement of complex representatives before localization in the proof of lem-sc-derived-pullback-translated-unit-triangles; Stacks 06YS and 06YJ, expanded using localization right fractions.

proof.text: Localize the distinguished homotopy triangle T₀ using DerivedCategory.Qh. Choose a cochain representative B of its second object and a K-flat resolution t:Q→B using [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. Localization inverts t and gives eQ:Qh(Q)≅(Qh(T₀)).obj₂.

Write (Qh(T₀)).mor₁ followed by eQ inverse as a right fraction α, using Mathlib Localization.exists_rightFraction for the homotopy quasi-isomorphisms. Represent its auxiliary object by a complex R and resolve R by a K-flat P using [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. Compose this augmentation with the numerator α.f and choose a cochain representative p:P→Q of that homotopy morphism. The augmentation and α.s are quasi-isomorphisms; their localized composite gives eP:Qh(P)≅(Qh(T₀)).obj₁.

RightFraction.map_s_comp_map gives Qh(p)≫eQ.hom=eP.hom≫(Qh(T₀)).mor₁. The localized cone triangle of p and Qh(T₀) are distinguished by Qh.map_distinguished and HomotopyCategory.mappingCone_triangleh_distinguished. Apply Pretriangulated.isoTriangleOfIso₁₂ with eP and eQ and take its inverse. All steps are formal Mathlib localization/triangulated APIs and composition identities.

theorem exists_kFlat_localized_cone_presentation (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (T₀ : Triangle (HomotopyCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (hT₀ : T₀ ∈ distTriang (HomotopyCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) :
    ∃ (P Q : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) (p : P ⟶ Q),
      CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) P ∧
      CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) Q ∧
      Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Qh.mapTriangle.obj T₀ ≅
        DerivedCategory.Qh.mapTriangle.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone.triangleh p))
